title: Relief faces are open surfaces: bodies can pass through the earth
summary: A displaced earth face is an open plane, so S.collide lets bodies pass through it. Give every relief a closed backing volume and list that as the solid.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: const b = backing(w, h, 4, std(0x1a140f, 1)); b.position.copy(face.position); G.add(b); solids.push(b);

doc.when: Figures near cut faces, tunnel walls, rough ground.
doc.avoid: Listing open planes as S.collide solids.

problem.symptom: A limb inside the earth with OVERLAP never reported.
problem.cause: The relief isn't a closed solid and isn't in S.collide.
problem.fix: A closed backing box behind each relief, listed in S.collide.solids.
problem.detect: Crops of figures near faces; S.collide solids list has no earth.
